function createControlledGraphTasks() {
  const records = [];
  let dispatching;
  const select = (id) => {
    const task = records.find((record) => record.id === id);
    if (!task) throw new Error("unknown exact controlled graph task");
    return task;
  };
  const dispatch = (task) => {
    if (dispatching !== void 0)
      throw new Error("nested controlled task dispatch is not a host-task cut");
    task.dispatches++;
    dispatching = task.id;
    try {
      task.callback();
    } finally {
      dispatching = void 0;
    }
  };
  return {
    scheduleGraphContinuation(callback) {
      const task = {
        id: records.length + 1,
        callback,
        cancelled: false,
        dispatches: 0
      };
      records.push(task);
      return () => {
        task.cancelled = true;
      };
    },
    dispatch(id) {
      const task = select(id);
      if (task.cancelled)
        throw new Error("use deliberate stale dispatch for a cancelled task");
      dispatch(task);
    },
    dispatchStale(id) {
      dispatch(select(id));
    },
    dispatching: () => dispatching,
    records: () => records.map(({ id, cancelled, dispatches }) => ({
      id,
      cancelled,
      dispatches
    }))
  };
};

function observeExactCandidateGraph(graph, queue) {
  const original = graph.run;
  const own = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(graph, "run");
  const entries = [];
  let nextFault;
  const wrapped = function(...args) {
    const dispatchId = queue.dispatching();
    const fault = dispatchId === void 0 ? void 0 : nextFault;
    if (fault) nextFault = void 0;
    entries.push({ dispatchId, faulted: fault !== void 0 });
    if (fault) throw fault.error;
    return original.apply(this, args);
  };
  graph.run = wrapped;
  return {
    entries: () => entries.map((entry) => ({ ...entry })),
    failNextDispatchedRun(error) {
      if (nextFault)
        throw new Error("an exact graph-run fault is already armed");
      nextFault = { error };
    },
    restore() {
      if (graph.run !== wrapped)
        throw new Error("exact graph-run instrument was replaced");
      if (own) Object.defineProperty(graph, "run", own);
      else Reflect.deleteProperty(graph, "run");
    }
  };
};
function observeCandidatePromise(promise) {
  let observation = { state: "pending" };
  void promise.then(
    () => {
      observation = { state: "fulfilled" };
    },
    (error) => {
      observation = { state: "rejected", error };
    }
  );
  return () => observation;
};
function failOneCandidatePublication(error, reached) {
  const deliveries = [];
  let injected = false;
  return {
    callback(delivery) {
      deliveries.push(delivery);
      if (!injected && reached(delivery)) {
        injected = true;
        throw error;
      }
    },
    observations: () => ({ injected, deliveries: [...deliveries] })
  };
};
function createCandidateReceiptObservations() {
  const receipts = [];
  const disposals = [];
  return {
    returned(target, attempt, receipt) {
      const record = {
        id: receipts.length + 1,
        target,
        attempt,
        receipt,
        observe: receipt === true ? () => ({ state: "fulfilled" }) : observeCandidatePromise(receipt)
      };
      receipts.push(record);
      return record.id;
    },
    disposing(target, attempt) {
      disposals.push({ target, attempt });
    },
    observations: () => ({
      receipts: receipts.map(({ id, target, attempt, receipt, observe }) => ({
        id,
        target,
        attempt,
        literalTrue: receipt === true,
        observation: observe()
      })),
      disposals: [...disposals]
    })
  };
};

async function captureCandidateHostGap(queue, taskId, readRoot, readDownstream, readWindow, operations) {
  const requireUndispatched = () => {
    const task = queue.records().find(({ id }) => id === taskId);
    if (!task || task.cancelled || task.dispatches !== 0)
      throw new Error("exact candidate task did not remain queued at host gap");
  };
  requireUndispatched();
  await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 0));
  requireUndispatched();
  return {
    root: readRoot(),
    downstream: readDownstream(),
    window: readWindow(),
    operations: operations.map((read) => read()),
    tasks: queue.records()
  };
}
